Delhi Capitals Begin IPL 2027 Preparations with Talent Trials

The Delhi Capitals franchise has commenced preparations for the 2027 Indian Premier League (IPL) season. The team's build-up includes overseeing a camp and conducting trials for domestic talent. Former cricketers Yuvraj Singh and Amit Mishra are involved in supervising these activities. Chaminda Vaas is also reported to be joining the Delhi Capitals for the upcoming season.
